verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a package-manager CLI, but nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, usage tracking, or an opt-out setting for npm. The generic config mechanisms (NPM_CONFIG_ environment variables, --key val switches) and the ability to switch or self-host registries are adjacent features, not a documented telemetry opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
